verdict: Leads grew this period, but cost per lead rose faster than volume.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Meta delivered all 27 leads at a cost of $10.39 per lead — the only active paid channel, with Google Ads at zero spend throughout. In the most recent 7 days, spend roughly doubled and lead volume rose 45%, but cost per lead climbed 42% alongside it, meaning the budget scaled faster than results followed. Two dark days on Oct 31 and Nov 1 interrupted the run and skew the short-term comparison, so we're reviewing pacing to prevent gaps like that from recurring. The focus this coming week is stabilising daily spend and holding cost per lead closer to the 28-day baseline.
